explanation: Negates the conjecture "finitely many n with a(n) ≢ 0 (mod a(n−1))" by asserting that {n > 1 | a(n−1) ∤ a(n)} is infinite. The definition (product of composites in [C(n,2)+1, C(n+1,2)]) matches A093456 and Steinerberger's comment. Divisibility a(n−1) | a(n) is the right reading of a(n) ≡ 0 (mod a(n−1)). The `research solved` tag with a linked formal proof is consistent with the docstring. The statement is faithful.
